pattern: join on two keys and derive one measure from each table
question: match the two tables for 2023 and show each district ANC completed over registered percent with employed over enrolled percent
gold_sql: SELECT a.district, ROUND(100.0 * a.anc4_completed / a.pregnancies_registered, 1) AS anc_percent, ROUND(100.0 * l.employed_at_6_months / l.women_enrolled, 1) AS employment_percent FROM anc_visits AS a INNER JOIN livelihoods AS l ON a.district = l.district AND a.year = l.year WHERE a.year = 2023 ORDER BY a.district
sql_duckdb: SELECT a.district, a.year, (a.anc4_completed * 100.0 / NULLIF(NULLIF(a.pregnancies_registered, 0), 0)) AS anc_completed_over_registered_percent, (l.employed_at_6_months * 100.0 / NULLIF(NULLIF(l.women_enrolled, 0), 0)) AS employed_over_enrolled_percent FROM anc_visits AS a JOIN livelihoods AS l ON a.district = l.district AND a.year = l.year WHERE a.year = 2023
